capabilities.activation: automatically applied throughout every mapped operation and action
capabilities.authorityEffect: supports reasoning and execution through mandatory constraints without independently authorizing product writes
capabilities.conflicts: Higher-priority repository and requester constraints remain authoritative; this capability may narrow but never expand authority.

capabilities.activation: when refactor intent is explicit or unambiguous
capabilities.authorityEffect: supports the selected refactor action by requiring exactly one mode before editing; it does not select that action
capabilities.conflicts: Infer safe preservation when clear; clarify only material behavior/scope differences.

capabilities.activation: Only for an actual executable change, explicit test request or concrete regression risk.
capabilities.authorityEffect: supports the selected action by classifying test need without independently authorizing test writes
capabilities.conflicts: A read-only operation may recommend but never create tests.

capabilities.activation: Proactively whenever current scoped work supports a useful recommendation or design decision; surface insufficient context visibly rather than guessing
capabilities.authorityEffect: supports reasoning inside the selected action without selecting the action or creating write intent
evidenceOutput: qualitative confidence with reason; conditional recommendation when supportable
capabilities.conflicts: A recommendation is not implementation authority; no fabricated facts, arbitrary confidence percentages, separate command, or new lifecycle.

capabilities.activation: explicit SQL explain intent or embedded explanation support needed during SQL analysis
requiredInputs: SQL text or pointed SQL object
capabilities.conflicts: A modification request routes to explicit action=edit or action=refactor; explain never edits or executes SQL.

capabilities.activation: Relevant schema, object or caller evidence is missing and a managed connected profile is available
capabilities.authorityEffect: Read-only managed context; never database mutation or execution of routines
capabilities.conflicts: User prohibition overrides all provider write capabilities; no metadata sync or database DDL/DML/EXEC inside agm-*. A direct owner request to sql-context-pack is that package's turn under its own approval gates (assets/skill-routing.json).

capabilities.activation: Explicit relevant bootstrap, branch, version or release work
capabilities.authorityEffect: Knowledge only; effects require current requester release or bootstrap scope
evidenceOutput: develop -> jenkins push Inhouse -> jenkins-release push Production
capabilities.conflicts: Quoted keywords never execute; bootstrap does not release or reset versions.
